scope: AI support assistant for guest bookings, changes and refunds
summary: Aivuna provides an AI customer-support assistant for Noma Journeys' guests, answering questions about bookings, changes and refunds by chat and email, from a 1 February 2027 launch. Go-live depends on Noma providing access to its booking system by 1 December.
deliverables: AI assistant answering guest questions on chat and email
Booking system connector, so the assistant reads each guest's booking
Handover of conversations the assistant cannot resolve to Noma's human agents
Implementation and configuration, 45 person-days; two training sessions
Weekly project status meeting during implementation

titles.v2-bc90ac870bbc11cb: Dedicated launch specialist for the first 30 days, at no extra charge
titles.v2-fe7a3f68b4853fc2: AI answers customers' phone calls at launch
